title: sagraea acuminata
intro: Sagraea acuminata, commonly known as the "Lobelia," is a plant species native to South America. The health benefits of Sagraea acuminata include its use as a diuretic and its potential in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sagraea acuminata include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and an antispasmodic, providing relief from muscle spasms and pain. Bioactive constituents of Sagraea acuminata include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
